name: Tenma Morei
source:
One of the Dai Tenma and a pillar of Yatsukahagi.

Accompanying with [url=https://vndb.org/c34809]Akuro[/url], [spoiler]unlike her brother/boyfriend[/spoiler], she is very enthusiastic and keeping a direct relationship with him.

"This kind of arrogance, this feeling......As expected, you bastard is the one to inherit it."

[spoiler]In truth she is the fusion of a heroine and another female character in [url=https://vndb.org/v548#main]Dies Irae[/url], as well as the sister and lover of [url=https://vndb.org/c34711]Kai Sakurai[/url], [url=https://vndb.org/c28991]Kei Sakurai[/url] and [url=https://vndb.org/c28999]Beatrice Kircheisen[/url], after the death of [url=https://vndb.org/c29001]Marie[/url], [url=https://vndb.org/c28998]Mercurius[/url] and [url=https://vndb.org/c22061]Reinhard Heydrich[/url], she along with other survived members of Marie universe joined in the group formed by [url=https://vndb.org/c22060]Ren[/url] in order to protect what's left of her world.[/spoiler]
